title: Leaving mall world?
content: Since mall world has gained consciousness popularity via Reddit, TikTok, insta, world of mouth, etc. I have not been dreaming about mall world in the same capacity as before. I used to go there every night but now when I dream, although just as vivid, I’m finding myself in different spaces I’ve never been before and it’s harder to predict than before all this hype. Is this just me?
